governance.constitution:
- Refine's components are model (entities), process (supervisor to manage running processes), prompts (LLM templates), surfaces (interfaces into refine), tools (reusable functions for workflow steps), and workflow (defined workflow which calls out to tools). These map directly to src/[model| process|prompts|surfaces|tools|workflow].
- Refine uses a flat file persistence, file-based indexes, in-memory caching, and Rust to maintain high performance. Ensure <50ms performance on CLI and API calls (assuming we are not waiting on LLMs or outside tools).
- Ensure that the architecture is maintained and is consistent. Do not invent new architectural concepts; instead, follow the existing architecture.
- Ensure that documentation, especially src/intent/*, is maintained and the existing document format is preserved.
- Ensure Refine remains "agent-first" by using installed coding-agent CLIs. Do not duplicate coding agent functionality.
governance.product: Refine is a local-first, agent-first operating layer for software delivery. It moves user-defined Goals through a workflow to ensure parallel implementation across Nodes, quality, and governance.

result.summary: The proposed plan is complete and correctly scopes the paused-workflow dashboard behavior and regression coverage.

checklist.description: Pass the existing canonical workflow pause flag from the runtime process summary into dashboard attention-item construction.
Make dashboard attention emit an informational workflow-paused banner when paused and reserve the runtime-worker error banner for an unpaused unreachable worker.
Extend focused dashboard regression coverage across paused and unpaused reachability states to lock in the new severity and preserve the genuine outage case.

result.summary: The dashboard will treat the canonical workflow pause state as an informational condition that takes precedence over runtime-worker reachability, so a paused workflow shows a neutral message that the workflow is paused without implying an error or prompting an auth re-check, while an unpaused and genuinely unreachable runtime still shows the existing failure guidance.

checklist.evidence: src/surfaces/web_server/project_routes/dashboard.rs reads normalized workflow_paused from the runtime process summary and passes it to dashboard_attention_items; the endpoint regression sets canonical pause state through FileProcessSupervisor and observes the informational dashboard banner.

src/surfaces/web_server/project_routes.rs emits an info-severity 'Workflow is paused.' banner whenever workflow_paused is true, before evaluating runner_reachable; only unpaused unreachable state emits the existing error banner and auth guidance.

src/surfaces/web_server/tests/project_runtime.rs covers all four paused/unpaused and reachable/unreachable combinations, preserves the genuine outage assertion, and verifies canonical runtime pause state through GET /api/dashboard.

Added four-state and endpoint regression coverage, updated Dashboard intent, and all final verification passed.
